description: This file defines the 'Packaging' interface, which declares methods for obtaining package details for shipping products within a merchant store context.

classes.name: Packaging
classes.description: An interface defining methods to retrieve package details for shipping products.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Retrieves package details for a list of shipping products in box packages, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Retrieves package details for individual items among shipping products, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
